svg.title: Four Core Seats, Two Explicit Scaling Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Two Explicit Scaling Additions; subtitle: Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time and C means contractor. Numeric values indicate baseline seat occupancy: four active seats and two inactive expansion seats. Activate both expansion seats to reach the six-person Scaled pod.; caption: The four-person pod supports the canonical $100,000 Conservative and $500,000 Base revenue cases. The six-person pod corresponds to $900,000 Scaled revenue; headcount alone does not establish demand.; stages: label: Owner and commercial lead; value: One full-time core seat owns economics; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own vendor relationships, pricing, customer commitments, concentration limits, and cash exposure. Review exception reports instead of manually rebuilding every partner statement.; label: Licensing operations specialist; value: One contractor core seat owns activation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Validate tenant boundaries, transfer eligibility, product identifiers, commitment dates, and distributor records. Maintain evidence for every customer-authorized license change.; label: Savings and procurement analyst; value: One contractor core seat owns measurement; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Build comparable incumbent baselines, test price floors, calculate contingent fees, and distinguish seat reductions from genuine like-for-like procurement savings.; label: Billing and collections specialist; value: One contractor core seat owns reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Match customer receipts, distributor charges, residual statements, and rebate settlements. Escalate funding gaps before a new annual vendor commitment is created.; label: Scaled operations manager; value: Add one full-time seat when scaling; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Join the existing owner to create two full-time seats. Own delivery capacity, workflow exceptions, contractor coordination, and renewal-service continuity.; label: Scaled portfolio analyst; value: Add one contractor seat when scaling; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Join the three core contractors to create four contractor seats. Expand renewal monitoring, rebate verification, and independent checks on shared-savings calculations.
